title: 5. Por que elas são o contrário do que confessam

queries.text: "Aqueles que as 'dobram'" (those who "fold"/"bend" them, i.e., who win them over and make them yield) → “bend.” Alternative: “win them over.”
"'o gostosão' ou 'o bonzão'" (slang augmentatives: the sexy guy, the great guy) → “the hunk” or “the top dog.” "Kids" is Larry Clark’s 1995 film.
"um 'banana'" (Brazilian slang for a spineless, weak man) → “wimp.” Alternative: “pushover.”
